# ITER — What Is a Tokamak

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** ITER Organization, “What Is a Tokamak?,” accessed July 14, 2026, https://www.iter.org/machine/what-tokamak.

**Shortened note:** ITER Organization, “What Is a Tokamak?”

**Bibliography:** ITER Organization. “What Is a Tokamak?” Accessed July 14, 2026. https://www.iter.org/machine/what-tokamak.

## Essay use

Institutional source for a tokamak's doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma, magnetic-coil control, and stated experimental limit. It supplies one physical instance of magnetic plasma confinement, not a full account of coupled toroidal/poloidal field-line geometry.

**Claim boundary:** this narrow technical source warrants the stated chamber, coils, plasma, and confinement description. It does not establish helical field lines, stellarator comparison, universal optimality in nature, or metaphysical fundamentality. Add a dedicated magnet-system/field-geometry source and alternative-confinement source before using those claims.

## Passage card — `iter-what-is-tokamak-q001` — Chamber, plasma, and magnetic confinement
^iter-what-is-tokamak-q001

> “The heart of a tokamak is its doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber. Inside, under the influence of extreme heat and pressure, gaseous hydrogen fuel becomes a plasma—a hot, electrically charged gas.”

- **Locator:** “Inside a tokamak,” paras. 1–2; page lines 232–235 in the 2026-07-14 inspection.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the official ITER page; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** supports.
- **Argument function:** physical contextualisation / technical warrant.
- **Consumers:** [[29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos|Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos]]; movement 29 chamber-and-plasma instance.
- **Use boundary:** establishes ITER's stated chamber and plasma description; it does not establish toroidal/poloidal field composition, helical geometry, a topology theorem, or a QL conclusion.

<a id="iter-what-is-tokamak-q002"></a>
## Passage card — `iter-what-is-tokamak-q002` — Experimental limitation
^iter-what-is-tokamak-q002

> “The operation of ITER will allow the ITER Members to test long-pulse operation and the many required technologies at reactor scale, but the machine won't be equipped to produce electricity.”

- **Locator:** opening section, para. 2; page lines 210–212 in the 2026-07-14 inspection.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the official ITER page; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** qualifies.
- **Argument function:** engineering limitation.
- **Consumers:** [[29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos|Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos]]; movement 29 engineering boundary.
- **Use boundary:** limits what ITER itself demonstrates about electricity production; it does not assess all magnetic-confinement architectures or metaphysical analogies.
